page_title: Wolfram|Alpha: Making the world’s knowledge computable

summary.name: Wolfram|Alpha
summary.one_liner: Wolfram|Alpha is a computational knowledge engine that answers natural-language or math-input queries with computed, curated-data results across mathematics, science, society, and everyday life.
use_cases: solving math problems step by step
looking up facts about countries, people, or history
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Wolfram|Alpha as a service that computes answers from natural-language questions or structured math input, described as verified, expert-level results drawn from Wolfram's algorithms and knowledgebase. It lists topic categories including Mathematics (with step-by-step solutions, plotting, calculus, geometry, differential equations, statistics), Science & Technology (units, physics, chemistry, engineering), Society & Culture (people, history, money, political geography), and Everyday Life (personal health, personal finance, household math). It states it is built on the Wolfram Language and draws on 35+ years of research. The page also links to mobile apps, a Pro tier, and API and developer offerings.
notable: Accepts both natural language queries and structured Math Input
Built on the Wolfram Language with a curated knowledgebase
Offers step-by-step solutions for math problems
Has a Pro upgrade tier, mobile apps, and an API for developers
caveats: Pro upgrade is mentioned, so some features likely require a paid tier (details not on page)
